name: valuation-platform
description: Australian property valuation inspection, workflow and reporting platform

scripts.check: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run docs:check
scripts.docs:generate: pnpm --filter @vp/api exec tsx --conditions=source scripts/generate-docs.ts && prettier --write docs/spec/generated docs/spec/02-personas-and-permissions.md --log-level warn
scripts.docs:check: pnpm run docs:generate && git diff --exit-code -- docs/spec/generated docs/spec/02-personas-and-permissions.md
